name: Toki, Tsunagu Yume ~Ano Koro no Sunaosa o~
original_name: トキ、ツナグユメ　～あの頃の素直さを～
source:
First day of the second semester of high school. Main character is unable to reconcile with his girlfriend for a week. He tries to avoid seeing her on the way to school. At this time a mysterious boy stops him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高中第二学期开学第一天。主人公已经整整一周没能与女友和好，上学途中还试图避开她。就在这时，一名神秘少年拦住了他。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
